name: csi
description: CSI skills for coding agents: csi (drive the user's real Chrome browser — navigate, click, type, screenshot, save PDF — via the local daemon), csi-e2e (turn natural-language browser scenarios into replayable e2e regression suites).

interface.shortDescription: Let the agent drive your real Chrome browser
interface.longDescription: CSI skills let the agent control the user's real Chrome browser — navigate, click, type, read pages, screenshot, save PDFs — through the local csi daemon, using the user's actual login sessions; csi-e2e turns natural-language browser scenarios into replayable e2e regression suites.
